items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment-cost, approved-budget, and learning-outcome records are incomplete, and monthly budget limits are blank. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue by tracking ID and site/content; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budget limits; and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold tied to a defined learning outcome.
